name: ask
description: Ask the second brain in plain words: semantic search over the curated vault with embeddings plus a reranker, returning the smallest relevant slice instead of a corpus dump. Token-cheap. Triggers: "/ask <question>", "what do I have on <topic>", "what did I write about X".
